seo_title: Private Food Tours Malaysia | Simply Enak
seo_description: Book a private food tour in Malaysia with Simply Enak. Your group only, your pace, your guide.
hero_subtitle: Your group, your pace, your guide  -  from just two people to a corporate team.
why_subtitle: You book the guide. You get the guide. No strangers, no compromises.

why_private.title: Your guide, your group
why_private.detail: No other guests on your tour. Your guide's full attention stays on your group all day  -  adjusting pace, answering questions, staying as long as you want at a stall.

why_private.title: Your schedule
why_private.detail: We set start times around you. Morning, late morning, evening  -  whatever works, and you're not waiting on strangers or cutting a stall short because someone else is tired.

why_private.title: Your interests
why_private.detail: Dietary needs, languages, how much you want to walk  -  we work all of this out with your guide before the day, not on it. Nothing is an afterthought.

configurator_body: Tell us who you are and what matters  -  we'll sketch a route and refine it on WhatsApp.

audiences.label: Families
audiences.detail: Set a pace the kids can handle. Stop when you need to. We've run private tours with children as young as four and adapted the route and commentary to match.

audiences.label: Couples
audiences.detail: No schedule pressure, no waiting for a group. A private tour is one of the more memorable ways to spend a day somewhere new  -  unhurried and genuinely yours.

audiences.label: Corporate groups
audiences.detail: Team meals and client visits that don't feel like team meals. We take groups to the stalls where Kuala Lumpur actually eats  -  not the restaurants on the tourist strip.

audiences.label: Special occasions
audiences.detail: Birthdays, anniversaries, farewell trips. We've marked all of them. Tell us what the occasion is and we'll shape the day around it.

private_extras: Pre-tour WhatsApp planning call with your guide
Flexible route  -  we adjust on the day if you want to linger
Dietary needs briefed in advance, not as an afterthought
Group photo stops whenever you want them
Start time that works for your schedule
pricing_heading: Pricing depends on group size and tour
pricing_body: Private tours are priced per group, not per head  -  so the more of you there are, the less each person pays. Send us your dates and group size and we'll come back with a quote within a few hours.
available_privately_subtext: Choose the tour that fits your group, then tell us you'd like it private.
corporate_callout: For corporate groups: We also take work groups and corporate visitors to the stalls locals eat at.

faqs.name: Is a private tour worth the extra cost?
faqs.answer: That depends on what you're after. If you want to move at your own pace, have the guide's full attention, and not worry about anyone else's dietary needs or energy levels  -  then yes, it's worth it. Most guests who book a private tour tell us afterwards they wish they'd done it from the start. If you're happy meeting other travellers and sharing the experience, a join-in tour gives you the same stalls and the same guides for less.

faqs.name: What's the minimum group size?
faqs.answer: Two people is fine  -  we've done it plenty of times. Most private groups run between 4 and 8. If there are two of you, you'll split the full tour rate between you rather than across a larger group, so it works out to more per head. Still worth it for a lot of couples.

faqs.name: Can we change the route?
faqs.answer: Once you book, your guide will reach out on WhatsApp before the day to go through the plan. If you'd like to add a stop, skip one, or linger somewhere longer, that's the time to say so. On the day itself we can adjust too  -  if you're loving a stall and want to stay, we stay.

faqs.name: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.answer: A week ahead is comfortable, two is better. We've pulled tours together in 48 hours when we had to, but it gives your guide more time to prepare and brief the stalls. For groups of 8 or more, three weeks is ideal.

faqs.name: Can you handle dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: That's one of the main reasons people go private. On a join-in tour we work around dietary needs on the day  -  on a private tour, we brief your guide and the stalls in advance so nothing is a surprise or an afterthought. Vegetarian, halal, allergies, strong dislikes  -  tell us when you enquire.

translations.seo_title: Tur Makanan Persendirian Malaysia | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Tempah lawatan makanan persendirian di Malaysia dengan Simply Enak. Kumpulan anda sahaja, mengikut kadar anda, pemandu pelancong anda.
translations.hero_subtitle: Kumpulan anda, rentak anda, pemandu anda – daripada hanya dua orang sehingga ke sebuah pasukan korporat.
translations.why_title: Apa yang dimaksudkan dengan lawatan persendirian
translations.why_subtitle: Anda tempah pemandu. Anda dapat pemandu. Tiada orang asing, tiada kompromi.
translations.configurator_body: Beritahu kami siapa anda dan apa yang penting — kami akan melakar laluan dan memperhalusinya di WhatsApp.
translations.private_extras_label: Apakah yang berubah apabila ia bersifat peribadi
translations.pricing_heading: Harga bergantung pada saiz kumpulan dan lawatan
translations.pricing_body: Lawatan persendirian dihargakan mengikut kumpulan, bukan setiap orang — jadi semakin ramai anda, semakin kurang bayaran setiap orang. Hantar tarikh dan saiz kumpulan anda kepada kami, dan kami akan membalas dengan sebut harga dalam beberapa jam.
translations.available_privately_heading: Setiap lawatan boleh didapati secara persendirian
translations.available_privately_subtext: Pilih lawatan yang sesuai dengan kumpulan anda, kemudian beritahu kami bahawa anda ingin ia secara persendirian.
translations.corporate_callout: Untuk kumpulan korporat: Kami juga membawa kumpulan kerja dan pelawat korporat ke gerai tempat penduduk tempatan makan.
translations.corporate_cta_text: Ketahui lebih lanjut tentang lawatan berkumpulan →

translations.seo_title: 马来西亚私人美食之旅 | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: 通过 Simply Enak 在马来西亚预订私人美食之旅。仅限您的团体，您的节奏，您的向导。
translations.hero_subtitle: 您的团队，您的节奏，您的向导 - 无论是两人小聚还是企业团队。
translations.why_subtitle: 你预订导游，就拥有专属导游。没有陌生人，绝不妥协。
translations.configurator_body: 告诉我们您是谁、什么对您重要——我们会勾勒一条路线，并在 WhatsApp 上与您一起完善它。
translations.private_extras_label: 当它是私人的时，有什么变化
translations.pricing_heading: 价格取决于团队人数和旅游项目
translations.pricing_body: 私人团的价格是按团体计价，而非按人头计费——所以人数越多，每个人支付的费用就越少。请把您的出行日期和团体人数发给我们，我们会在几小时内回复您报价。
translations.available_privately_heading: 每条游览线路均可提供私人服务
translations.available_privately_subtext: 选择适合您团队的旅游路线，然后告诉我们您希望将其设为私人定制。
translations.corporate_callout: 针对企业团体：我们也会带领工作团队及企业参观者前往本地人光顾的摊位用餐。
translations.corporate_cta_text: 了解团体旅游的更多信息 →

translations.seo_description: Buchen Sie eine private Food-Tour in Malaysia mit Simply Enak. Nur Ihre Gruppe, Ihr Tempo, Ihr Guide.
translations.hero_title: Eine Tour, die ganz auf Sie zugeschnitten ist
translations.hero_subtitle: Eure Gruppe, euer Tempo, euer Guide – von nur zwei Personen bis zum Firmenteam.
translations.why_subtitle: Sie buchen den Guide. Sie bekommen den Guide. Keine Fremden, keine Kompromisse.
translations.configurator_body: Erzähl uns, wer du bist und was dir wichtig ist – wir skizzieren eine Route und feilen sie mit dir per WhatsApp aus.
translations.private_extras_label: Was ändert sich, wenn es privat ist
translations.pricing_heading: Der Preis hängt von der Gruppengröße und der Tour ab.
translations.pricing_body: Private Touren werden pro Gruppe berechnet, nicht pro Person – je mehr von euch dabei sind, desto weniger zahlt jede Person. Schickt uns eure Termine und die Gruppengröße, und wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Stunden mit einem Angebot zurück.
translations.available_privately_subtext: Wählen Sie die Tour, die zu Ihrer Gruppe passt, und teilen Sie uns mit, dass Sie sie als private Tour wünschen.
translations.corporate_callout: Für Firmengruppen: Wir nehmen auch Arbeitsgruppen und Firmenbesucher mit zu den Ständen, an denen Einheimische essen.

translations.seo_title: Tours Gastronómicos Privados Malasia | Simply Enak
translations.seo_description: Reserve un tour gastronómico privado en Malasia con Simply Enak. Solo su grupo, su ritmo, su guía.
translations.hero_subtitle: Tu grupo, tu ritmo, tu guía: desde solo dos personas hasta un equipo corporativo.
translations.why_title: Lo que significa un tour privado.
translations.why_subtitle: Reservas la guía. Obtienes la guía. Sin desconocidos, sin compromisos.
translations.configurator_body: Cuéntenos quién es y qué le importa: trazaremos una ruta y la refinaremos por WhatsApp.
translations.pricing_heading: El precio depende del tamaño del grupo y del tour.
translations.pricing_body: Los tours privados tienen precio por grupo, no por persona; así que cuanto más人数 sean, menos paga cada uno. Envíenos sus fechas y el tamaño del grupo y le enviaremos un presupuesto en pocas horas.
translations.available_privately_heading: Cada tour está disponible de forma privada.
translations.available_privately_subtext: Elige el tour que se adapte a tu grupo, luego dinos que te gustaría que fuera privado.
translations.corporate_callout: Para grupos corporativos: También llevamos a grupos de trabajo y visitantes corporativos a los puestos donde comen los lugareños.
